s1.label: RB-07 checkout runbook, as found
s1.text:
# RB-07 Checkout payments failing
Alert: checkout_payment_error_rate above 5% for 5 min

1. Open the payments dashboard and check if the error rate looks high.
2. Restart the payment adapter.
   $ kubectl rollout restart deploy/pay-adapter -n checkout
3. Investigate the provider status page as appropriate.
4. If it happened yesterday too, fail over to the backup provider.
   $ ./switch-provider.sh backup
5. Post in #payments when things look ok.

s2.label: RB-07 checkout runbook, rewritten
s2.text:
# RB-07 Checkout payments failing
Owner: payments on-call lead
Last verified: 2026-10-02 by drill (newcomer, 11 min)
Alert: checkout_payment_error_rate above 5% for 5 min

1. Read the error rate on the Checkout payments panel.
   Confirm it is above 5% before going on. Below 5%: resolve the page and stop.
2. Restart the payment adapter.
   $ kubectl rollout restart deploy/pay-adapter -n checkout
   Expected: deployment "pay-adapter" restarted
   Confirm the error rate falls below 2% within 5 minutes.
3. Still above 2%: open the provider status page and read the checkout line.
   It says degraded: go to step 4. It says operational: page the payments lead.
4. Fail over to the backup provider.
   $ ./switch-provider.sh backup
   Expected: active provider: backup
   Confirm new orders show provider=backup on the panel.
5. Post the time in UTC and the step you reached in #payments.

s3.text:
# PM-11 Wrong prices shown to customers
Status: draft

## Timeline
This morning around 9am the supplier file arrived.
09:40 Priya pushed the feed without looking at the diff.
12:40 Prices were fixed.

## Impact
Some customers saw wrong prices for a while.

## Contributing conditions
The validator should have caught it. Priya failed to check the outliers.

## Actions
- Make validation better
- Be more careful with supplier files
- Add an outlier check. Owner: pricing lead

s4.label: PM-11 pricing-feed postmortem, team version
s4.text:
# PM-11 Wrong prices shown to customers
Owner: pricing lead
Last updated: 2026-11-04

## Timeline (UTC)
2026-10-28 08:55 UTC supplier file arrives with prices in cents, not pounds.
2026-10-28 09:40 UTC feed accepted; the validator checks the schema, not the values.
2026-10-28 12:40 UTC prices restored from the last accepted feed.

## Impact
3 hours of wrong prices on 1,140 products; 2,310 orders placed; 412 orders refunded the difference.

## Contributing conditions
The validator compared columns, never values. No alert watched for a price jump against the last feed. The runbook for feed rejection had no step for a feed that passes.

## Actions
- Add an outlier check against the last accepted feed. Owner: pricing lead. Due: 2026-11-25
- Page on more than 50 price changes above 30% in one file. Owner: pricing on-call. Due: 2026-11-18
- Drill RB-11 with a newcomer. Owner: pricing lead. Due: 2026-12-09
